metadata.title: Exotic knot traces and the epsilon-invariant
metadata.abstract: Building on recent work of Hom and Wan, we construct additional examples of exotic knot traces, providing partial progress toward their conjecture. Our approach uses the immersed-curve techniques in Heegaard Floer homology developed by Chen and Hanselman.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Heegaard Floer 方法构造异结迹
analysis.workSummary: 在 Hom–Wan 工作基础上，用 Chen–Hanselman 的 Heegaard Floer 浸入曲线技术构造更多 exotic knot traces。
analysis.breakthrough: 为相关结迹猜想补充新的异光滑结构实例。
analysis.limitations: 作者表述为对猜想的部分进展；新增实例不等于完整分类或全部猜想证明。
